elements.label: Figure 1.10
elements.title: Average Terms on New External Debt Commitments for IDA-Eligible Countries, by Creditor Type, 2015–25

axes.y: Grace period and maturity (years); interest (percent, right axis)

elements.description: Two panels show grace periods, maturities and interest rates on new external debt commitments to IDA-eligible countries from 2015 to 2025, for private and official creditors respectively. Private-creditor interest falls to a low in 2020 before rising to its highest level in 2025, while private maturities peak around 2019 and grace periods fall sharply after 2021. Official-creditor maturities remain much longer, at roughly 23–26 years, and official interest rates peak around 2023.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
